Best practices

Give a check it can run: tests, a build, a screenshot to compare. It is the difference between a watched session and an unattended one.

Reference specific files, mention constraints, and point to example patterns in the codebase.

Provide context

The more precise your instructions, the fewer corrections you will need to make later on.

pytest -q
  tests/test_date.py
